crops_there.name: Oil palm
crops_there.note: Humid-tropic plantation perennial. Needs high rainfall spread evenly across the year.

crops_there.name: Cassava
crops_there.note: Drought-hardy tropical root crop. Very wide rainfall tolerance; frost-free year-round required.

crops_there.name: Taro
crops_there.note: Wetland root crop, thrives in waterlogged soils like rice. Needs high, reliable rainfall.

crops_there.name: Durian
crops_there.note: Tropical fruit tree, very narrow climate window. Needs high heat, high humidity, no frost.

crops_there.name: Rubber
crops_there.note: Humid-tropic plantation tree. Long dry spells reduce latex flow; no frost tolerance.

crops_there.name: Paddy rice
crops_there.note: Staple wetland cereal. Needs standing water and warm nights; grain-filling fails above ~35C at flowering.

crops_there.name: Banana
crops_there.note: Tropical perennial needing steady moisture and warmth. Wind and cold both damage it.

crops_there.name: Jackfruit
crops_there.note: Hardy tropical fruit tree. Wider climate range than durian; frost-sensitive. Poor drought and flooding tolerance.

caveats: NASA POWER is gridded climate data at roughly 50 km, not a measurement of this specific field.
We do not forecast weather, yield, or profit.
A linear trend is a simplifying assumption, not a climate projection.
Confirm any planting decision with a local agricultural adviser.
